posts.author: Matt Gelb
posts.text: For the third straight postseason, the Phillies blow a Game 1 lead in the seventh inning or later. It's happening all over again. They lose, 5-3, and they face elimination Wednesday afternoon.

reply_texts.text:
Bullpen deserves blame, but the Phillies have only scored 4+ runs twice in their last 11 postseason games as well. 

The only 2 games they have won.

posts.author: Andy Kostka
posts.text: BARCS announces the families of Pete Alonso, Kyle Bradish and Samuel Basallo are sponsoring a program at the shelter in which adoption fees and take-home essentials are covered by those. BARCS’ MVP Program highlights animals who are there a bit longer find loving homes.
posts.jp: BARCSがPete Alonso、Kyle Bradish、Samuel Basalloの家族がシェルターのプログラム協力を発表。同団体による譲渡費用と必需品をカバー。MVP制度で長期滞在のペットに家を。

posts.author: Matt Gelb
posts.text: Phillies do not have Brooks Raley on their Wild Card roster, which means all three players they acquired at trade deadline — Arraez, Kilian, Raley — are off.
posts.jp: フィリーズはBrooks Raleyをワイルドカードシリーズロスターから外した。トレード期限で獲得した3選手全員がリストから除外。
